mission: Execute the Adumar raid — dispatch the Dammant Killers cell and destroy the missile stockpile. Establish Jacen's surgical lethality as a data point the reader and Nelani both notice.
why_now: The team is at the hatch; once they commit, the raid is on.
opening_hook: Nelani's blue blade comes up through the hatch-plate in a clean vertical cut.
conflict: Dammant Killers cell defending the stockpile versus a three-Jedi strike team applying escalating force.
turning_point: Jacen's one-and-done dispatch of the cell leader — efficient past the bounds of Jedi preference — is visible to Nelani without being speakable.
closing_hook: The stockpile burning behind them as they leave through a service tunnel; Nelani glancing once at Jacen and not asking.
setting: Interior of the Dammant Killers missile factory — stockpile bay, adjoining offices, service corridors; Adumar.
sensory_details: Smoke from thermite charges; the particular resinous smell of missile propellant; the hum of Nelani's blue saber against the hiss of Jacen's green.
emotional_trajectory: Controlled assault → brief surprise at Jacen's lethality → operational withdrawal.

stakes.personal: Jacen's self-image as a Jedi who still uses only necessary force.
stakes.interpersonal: Nelani's trust in Jacen as a field partner.
stakes.external: The missile stockpile and the Dammant Killers cell carrying it.

action_beats: Jacen dispatches the cell leader one-and-done
The team fires the stockpile and withdraws
notes: The cell leader kill is the reader's first specific data point on Jacen's moral slide.
